text: I also just moved here (already in Israel) and it took us 10 months to get the partner visa approval. Now, they only gave me 6 month visa and I am not allowed to work here during the entire 6 months. So I find it important to know for yourself. Also, upon receiving the 6 months visa I was told that I can't leave the country for the time of the first 6 months. Which is impossible for me to do due to pre agreed commitments abroad. I would factor that in when you come here.
